notes.title: Patch #1 Is live.
notes.content:
The first of two major patches just went live. 21:00 - 04/10/15

Patch #1:

    [*]Interact with the undead! 
In the first major patch you'll be able to approach a zombie without perma-death being the only outcome. I'm implementing a sort of quick time event, where you'll haver to press a button(left click/space bar) at the right time to dodge a zombie's grips. Please keep in mind, this will NOT be easy, you should avoid the undead as per usual.


    [*]Fixed wall walking and collision.

    [*]Fixed some small issues with getting locked in houses, going into houses and exiting into far away area.

    [*]Fixed the mouse resolution lock. Where a small amount of users were unable to resize the window with F5 or it messed the mouse up.

    [*]More content, for free. New areas, new story/quest content.


    [*]Fixed Mini-game bugs.
[/list]

Thanks everyone, I hope you enjoy getting lost in post apocalyptic downtown Boston.

Dan.ːGorumː
